scenarios.eventDescription: Gretta stands by the window, listening to the song. There is a look of deep longing on her face.

options.text: She is simply enjoying the music
She is remembering someone from her past
She is unhappy with our marriage

scenarios.eventDescription: The song 'The Lass of Aughrim' plays, and Gretta seems deeply moved.

options.text: The song reminds her of Michael Furey
She misses her family in Galway

scenarios.eventDescription: Michael Furey waits in the snow for Gretta, even as the cold bites into him.

options.text: His love is so strong he would die for it
He is trying to prove something

scenarios.eventDescription: Gretta tells Gabriel about Michael Furey and his death.

options.text: She has been unfaithful in her heart
She needs to honor Michael's memory

scenarios.eventDescription: Gabriel watches the snow fall and understands the truth about love and death.

options.text: He understands Gretta's love for Michael
